title: Inklusive Franz Xaver Kroetz 1971

description.main: The first English translation of Franz Xaver Kroetz's 1971 play Inklusive, edited and introduced by Christopher Williams. Williams Studio produced the translation with Maximilian Klemens Sänger as part of Williams's research into Kroetz's work for theatre, radio and television.
description.extended:
Inklusive is the first English translation of Franz Xaver Kroetz's 1971 play, edited and introduced by Christopher Williams.

Kroetz wrote the play in 1971 as part of Trilogie Münchener Lebens, a trilogy of radio plays. Südwestfunk first broadcast it on 24 February 1972, and it reached the stage at the Düsseldorfer Schauspielhaus in 1976 as Herzliche Grüße aus Grado. In his introduction Williams describes seven scenes of sparse dialogue in Bavarian dialect that follow a working-class West German couple on a prepaid all-inclusive holiday in Italy. The couple works through a standard list of tourist activities, from sunbathing to boat rides and outdoor concerts. Williams Studio produced the translation with Maximilian Klemens Sänger, and Petra Hollenbach designed the 42-page softcover.

Williams, born in Los Angeles in 1956, made the translation as part of his ongoing research into Kroetz's work for theatre, radio and television. He later recorded his own adaptation of Inklusive as a radio play, which the Neubauer Collegium in Chicago broadcast on Lumpen Radio during his 2024 exhibition Radio/Rauhfaser/Television. Walther König has since published further books from this research, including Theater in Review: Upper Austria (2024).

notes: Two cover variants exist. Zwirner's hi-res image (9fdd3937...-1772x2717.jpg) omits the studio address and looks like a mockup sharing the Theatre in Review template. The Capitain Petzel image (835×1280) shows 'Studio Williams, Brüsseler Strasse 94, 50672 Köln' and matches the AbeBooks trade image, so it was used. Publication history (Südwestfunk 24 Feb 1972; Düsseldorfer Schauspielhaus 19 Sep 1976 as 'Herzliche Grüße aus Grado'; TV 12 Jun 1972 Hessischer Rundfunk) comes from the AbeBooks catalogue title for this ISBN.
